void nat_upnp_close (nat_upnp_context_t ** ctx)

Close port mapping and clean up. Removes the port mapping from the gateway and frees resources. Safe to call with NULL.

Parameters

ctx Context handle (will be set to NULL on return)

270       // Fios gateways require an explicit wildcard when deleting an unrestricted mapping.

272         result = UPNP_DeletePortMapping((*ctx)->control_url, (*ctx)->service_type, port, mapping_protocol(*ctx), "*");
273       }

275         log_debug("UPnP: deletion failed: %s (%d)", strupnperror(result), result);

278       error = (result == UPNPCOMMAND_SUCCESS || result == 714) ? ASCIICHAT_OK : ERROR_NETWORK;
279 #endif

282       log_warn("NAT: could not remove mapping for port %u; its lease will expire", (*ctx)->mapped_port);
283     } else {
284       log_info("NAT: removed mapping for port %u", (*ctx)->mapped_port);
285     }
286   }
287   SAFE_FREE((*ctx)->control_url);

asciichat_error_t nat_upnp_open (uint16_t
  internal_port, const char * description, nat_upnp_context_t **
  ctx)


Discover and open port via UPnP. Attempts to find an UPnP-enabled
    gateway and request port mapping. On success, fills in external_ip and
    mapped_port.




Parameters


internal_port Local TCP port to map (e.g., 27224
  for ACDS)


description Description for port mapping (e.g., "ascii-chat
  Server")


ctx Context handle (must be freed with nat_upnp_close())


Returns


ASCIICHAT_OK if port was successfully mapped



ERROR_NETWORK_* if discovery or mapping failed (does not determine
    listener reachability)




Example:




nat_upnp_context_t *ctx = NULL;
asciichat_error_t result = nat_upnp_open(27224, "ascii-chat Server", &ctx);
if (result == ASCIICHAT_OK && ctx) {


    printf("Public IP: %s\n", ctx->external_ip);


    // Advertise ctx->external_ip:ctx->mapped_port to ACDS
}

asciichat_error_t nat_upnp_refresh
  (nat_upnp_context_t * ctx)


Refresh port mapping (e.g., for long-running servers). Call from
    one owning thread when refresh_at_ns is reached. Renewal is scheduled
    halfway through the lease; failures schedule a bounded retry.




Parameters


ctx Context handle


Returns


ASCIICHAT_OK if refresh succeeded
